fusions.name: Workers' Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses 5 needle blades at once in a spread out to 5 tiles, each of which deals 2 damage.

fusions.name: Spent Stinger
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Hive of Needles
fusions.desc: Looses a swarm of needle blades for 12 seconds. Every second it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stinger in the Wake
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, a sting leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
